violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. The certified food manager’s certificate hand expired.
violations.corrective_action: Renew the expired certificate or obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ASH =107F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CORRECTED. Item was DISCARDED DURING THE InSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Unsalted butter=51F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CORRECTED. Butter discarded during the inspection.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: yogurt, hummus, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Z Burger (Inspection Date: 09/04/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Salt, hummus, yogurt, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived at the end of the inspection. CORRECTED.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: Ice cream containers were not covered to protect the ice cream from contamination, inside the chest freezer. The chest freezer contains excess ice buildup an d spoiled with spilled ice cream.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled.The ice cream containers were covered during the inspection.CORRECTED.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Equipment food-contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before any possible contamination. The can opener blade was observed to be soiled with residue accumulation.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. CORRECTED

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Z- sauce( made on. Site)=65F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. sauce were removed from room. Temperature and replaced with sauces that were 41F and less, from the walk-in refrigerator.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. The available food thermometer is not operating.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Several unmarked squeeze bottles containing sauces were not labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Bottles labeled during the inspection.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Ice cream scoop found stored in stagnant water, in a container in-between use.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Water discarded and scoop placed on a dry cleaned food contact surface.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Small cups without Handles were found used for dispensing ice cream toppings.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. Provided scoops with handles to dispense these toppings. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH/CHLORINE test kit for mint or the chlorine sanitizer concentration in the water at the 3-compartment sink, and for soaking wet wiping towels. Test kit ordered by on line by the CFM, during the inspection. CORRECTED, Z Burger (Inspection Date: 03/11/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the hand washing sink in the cooking area, is slow to drain. Also, the hand washing sink in the restroom has low pressure and insufficient water velocity, for proper hand washing.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. unclog the slow draining hand sink in the kitchen an d adjust the water pressure and velocity in the restroom.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution for soaking wet wiping towels, was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the solution was noted to be zero ppm, for Total CHLORINE concentration.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPEC TION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink in the customer restroom, is not providing hot water at proper temperature.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Room, Kept Closed
violations.observation: Observed that toilet room doors are being kept open. The self-closing device is missing.
violations.corrective_action: Keep toilet room doors closed to prevent insect and rodent entrance and the associated spread of potential disease. Replace the self-closing device

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Rw chicken observed stored above RTE sauce inns the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Food containers properly rearranged during the inspection.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Z-Burger sauce (two large containers)
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. The two containers were properly dated marked during the inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. After each use, soak wet wiping towels in the sanitizing solution . Check the solution to ensure that the sanitizer concentration is adequate as discussed. Z Burger (Inspection Date: 10/22/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: Hot water was not available at any of the sinks on premises on arrival at this food establishment. Observed temperature was, 71, 74, 72F.
violations.corrective_action: Provide adequate hot water at all the sinks. Hand washing sinks=100 F minimum; 3-Vat sink and prep sink=110F, minimum. Check the hand sinks often to verify hot water availability and actual temperature.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the HAND WASING SINSK AT THE WARE WASHING STATION WAS COMPETENTLY DISCONNECTED CAUSING the piping below to leak profusely when the sink is operated or attempted to be operated.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Repair the piping below this sink or connect the piping SECURELY IN PLACE, to prevent future leaks and disconnections of the piping.
